EventText: Thank the stars you made it.
The empire caught us by suprise. We barely got out alive. This is it. We're all that's left of the fleet.
Our ship is badly damaged, and some our systems our down, but we must get back and running and get to the [color=yellow]beacon[/color] at the end of this sector before the empire hunt us down.
As you jump into this beacon a small space station orbiting a moon hails you.
Our long range sensors detected a large battle with the empire. We're preparing for them. This is our home we will not give it up.
We don't have much to offer you, but we can refuel you and give you some parts. Better than it falling into the hands of the empire if we fall
